historical_commentary.text: This note covers 4D Open's data-manipulation side (entering/deleting/searching/sorting data, handling Blobs and Sets) and highlights one of 4D Open's genuine selling points at the time: a thin-client footprint (a 264KB DLL versus an 8.6MB full 4D client). 4D Open, the C/C++/Java API precursor to modern client-server access technologies, has been discontinued for many years; developers building thin, programmatic clients against 4D data today use 4D's REST/ORDA web data server instead, which did not exist at the time this note was written.
related_updates: 4D Open has been discontinued; there is no direct modern successor product by that name
4D's REST/ORDA data server now provides the modern equivalent of thin, programmatic, cross-platform access to 4D Server data that 4D Open aimed to provide in 2000
